name: Tucson Village Farm Camps: Teen Leadership and Counselor Roles
org: Tucson Village Farm, Pima County Cooperative Extension, University of Arizona
what_you_do: Help run summer camps for kids at the farm. The page says teens can apply for leadership and counselor roles. Camps cover cooking, farm life, art, river rafting and more.
who_can_apply: Camps are for youth ages 5 to 18. The page does not give an age rule for teen counselors. Ask the camp coordinator.
deadline_text: Counselor applications for 2027 camps go live Monday, March 1, 2027 at noon.
how_to_apply: Counselor applications open March 1, 2027 at noon on the camps page. Email the Camp Coordinator Moonie with questions.
notes: Applications for camper scholarships and sign-up open the same day. The page does not say if counselor jobs are paid.
